stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 40 m by 25 m is surrounded by a path 3 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $46$ m by $31$ m, an area of $1426$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $1000$ square m leaves $426$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
